evidence.claim: Suominen produce tessuti non tessuti in rotoli per salviette e altre applicazioni, con quasi 700 persone tra Europa e Americhe.
evidence.quote: Suominen manufactures nonwovens as roll goods for wipes and other applications. || Suominen's net sales in 2025 were EUR 412.4 million and we have almost 700 professionals working in Europe and in the Americas.
